## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：应用作者运行翻译检查时，没有界面步骤、也没有审批步骤的流程（定时、记录触发、接口流程）现在也会被提示缺少流程名称的译文；终端用户无感，直到作者补上译文后，手册里的流程卡片标题在中文下不再是英文。
- 为什么做：上一轮让流程图里每个步骤名都能翻译，但卡片标题（流程名）只对含界面或审批步骤的流程要求翻译，中文读者会看到英文标题压在中文步骤上。
- 出错会怎样：只多报缺译提示、不改任何运行行为或数据；示例应用的缺译基线随之上调，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**Landing point: `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, `walkScreenFlows`, as the dispatch expected.** `flows.FLOW_NAME.label` is now demanded for every flow with a `name`, instead of only a flow holding a `screen` or `approval` node. The comment over the demand now names the key's three readers and says why the third draws any flow.

**Why every declared flow is "drawn" (the card's rule: "a string nobody reads is not demanded").** The docs viewer's `type: flow` embed titles its card by `translated?.flowLabel` for whichever flow a page names, whatever its nodes (`metadata-viewer.tsx:572`). The walk already treats that embed as drawing every declared flow: since #36383 it asks every flow's drawn steps for `flows.FLOW_NAME.nodes.NODE_ID.label`, with no screen/approval predicate (ruling 7076440876, item 1: "A flow node gets a translatable label key under the flow's translation bundle (spec, validation and the business-view reader), so every drawn step (start, end, decision, notify, approval) can carry a label per language."). A card whose steps are demanded and whose title is not is the exact symptom the card describes. So this does not turn on a new product reading: the population is the one the `nodes` demand already uses. Independently, the Studio flow designer's rail names every flow of the package by the same key (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx:8508`, objectstack#35319), though the walk does not use the Studio as a demand basis (its own comment: "the walk asks only for what the docs embed draws").

**The card's "embedded flow" premise, measured.** The card reads "embedded" as an object's or an app's bundled flows. No such declaration site exists: the spec refuses both (tables below). PR #36383's acceptance note 1 used "embedded flow" for a flow drawn by the docs `type: flow` embed, and that is what this PR covers. The acceptance arm "a flow nobody draws is not" therefore has one real member: a flow with no `name`, which no bundle entry can address (pinned).

**Unchanged on purpose.** `successMessage` stays demanded only for a flow with a screen (its one reader is the screen runner); the `nodes`, `screens`, `approvals`, `refusals`, `notices` and `records` families are untouched. `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts` changes one comment word ("Screen-flow copy" to "Flow copy, every flow's label").

### Census 1: readers that draw a flow's label

| Reader | Where (origin/main 65ee4b7ad) | Which flows it draws |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Screen-flow runner header and completion toast | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx:434-445` (`translateFlow(...).label`); hosts pass the served label in at `FlowRunsPage.tsx:408`, `RecordDetailView.tsx:2300`, `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:814` | a run paused at a screen |
| Approvals door (inbox, record panel, request page) | `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/reader-locale-labels.ts:129` (`flowLabelKey`), `:356-358` | a flow whose `approval` node opened a request |
| Docs viewer `type: flow` embed, card title | `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/metadata-viewer.tsx:556` (`useFlowLabelTranslations`), `:572` (title) | any flow a docs page names, any node types |
| Studio flow designer: rail row and open-flow header | `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx:8508` (rail), `:8632` / `:9965` (header), via `metadata-admin/previews/flow-label-translations.tsx:43-45` and `ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts:67-77` | every flow of the package (not a demand basis for the walk) |

### Census 2: where a flow can be declared

| Site | Evidence | Walked? |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Top-level `flows` | `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:965` (`flows: z.array(FlowSchema)`) | yes, `config.flows` |
| Composed / plugin-contributed | `composeStacks` concatenates `flows` (`stack.zod.ts:1677`), last wins by name (`:3396`); each contributed flow is a top-level flow of its own stack, and the ten bundle packages run the walk on their own extract configs | yes, as top-level flows of the composed or contributing config |
| Object-embedded | does not exist: `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:1887-1895` refuses `workflows` / `workflow` and points at a top-level flow | n/a |
| App-bundled | does not exist: `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:1895-1897`, "`flows` is not an App field — flows are top-level stack metadata" | n/a |
| Install manifest / deploy bundle | `system/app-install.zod.ts:52`, `system/deploy-bundle.zod.ts:201,229`: names or serialized copies of the same top-level flows, not authoring sites | n/a |

## Read first (by risk)

1. `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, the `flows.FLOW_NAME.label` block at the top of `walkScreenFlows`: the predicate is gone, `hasScreen` survives only for `successMessage`.
2. `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json`: two rows rise, nothing else moves.
3. `packages/cli/test/i18n-flow-screen-coverage.test.ts`, the renamed describe "the flow label is demanded for every named flow".

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/i18n-flow-screen-coverage.test.ts test/i18n-flow-approval-coverage.test.ts` (after building the cli dependency closure); expect 39 passed, including the scheduled `nightly_digest` asked for its label and a nameless flow asked for nothing.

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins changed (the five that pinned the narrow predicate, rewritten to the new rule)</summary>

- `packages/cli/test/i18n-flow-screen-coverage.test.ts`: the describe is now "the flow label is demanded for every named flow": a scheduled flow with no screen emits `flows.nightly_digest.label` seeded with its label; a flow with `name` absent or empty emits nothing; the coverage gate lists both flows' labels in one tree and goes quiet for the one translated. The region-table pin's `http` payload flow now expects its label and still no screen key.
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-flow-approval-coverage.test.ts`: the scheduled flow emits only its label (no approval or screen key), and the gate asks the scheduled flow for its label alone.
</details>

<details><summary>Runs (head 385ed2b42)</summary>

- Before the pin edits, the 60 cli unit files matching i18n / translation / lint: `Test Files 2 failed | 58 passed (60)`, `Tests 5 failed | 652 passed (657)`; the five failures were exactly the narrow-predicate pins above.
- After: the four flow family files, `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 55 passed (55)`.
- `@objectstack/lint` whole suite: `Test Files 229 passed (229)`, `Tests 9513 passed (9513)`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- Ablation (lint resolves through `dist/` in the cli suite, so each leg rebuilt `@objectstack/lint`): the old predicate put back under a marker that survives the build, `ablation-dist-preflight` "marker present in 2 built files", the two pin files `Tests 5 failed | 34 passed (39)`; restored (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), rebuilt, preflight `--absent` green, `Tests 39 passed (39)`. A first attempt used a comment marker the build strips, so its preflight failed and its reading was discarded.
- `node scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs` before `--update`: `app-showcase 425 -> 449`, `app-todo 130 -> 136`; the new `os lint` findings are exactly 24 showcase flow labels (one locale each) and 3 todo flow labels (two locales each). After `--update`: OK. `pnpm check:i18n`: all ten bundle packages in sync.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` at 385ed2b42: 75 commands, 73 exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite refusals unrelated to this diff: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needs an unshallow clone for its pinned fixture, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a full `pnpm build`; both left to CI). `dispatch-gates --ran` with recorded exit codes: "75 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 73 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". Inside the sweep: `check:i18n-coverage` "OK (14 config(s), 585 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)", `check:i18n-walk-parity` "17 declared group(s), 15 walked, 2 exempted", `check:nul-bytes` exit 0.
- `overlap-check.mjs`: merges cleanly with `origin/main`, no open PR shares a file.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "embedded flow" (an object's or app's bundled flows) is not a declaration site the spec accepts; see census 2. The widened demand covers every declared flow because the docs flow embed draws any of them.
- The 24 showcase and 3 todo flow labels are ratcheted, not translated, as #36383 did for its population.
- Ruling governing the population: 7076440876 (quoted above). No `ruling`, `maintainer` or ⛔ line in the two edited files sits inside the edited block; the nearest cited record is #24916 (the approvals door), kept as the second reader.
